content.short: AIOZ Network is a decentralized CDN built on its own Layer 1 blockchain, revolutionizing media streaming.
content.description: AIOZ Network is a comprehensive Web3 infrastructure platform that provides a decentralized Content Delivery Network (dCDN), AI computing, and data storage services. Built on its own highly interoperable Layer 1 blockchain that bridges Cosmos and Ethereum, AIOZ enables developers to build and scale media-heavy applications with significantly lower costs compared to traditional cloud providers. By leveraging a global network of community-run nodes, the protocol ensures low-latency streaming and secure file distribution. The platform's integrated AI capabilities further empower creators to process and analyze content directly on the decentralized edge, creating a more efficient digital economy.
content.meta: AIOZ Network provides decentralized infrastructure for media, AI, and storage, offering a scalable and cost-effective alternative to centralized CDNs.
